title: what I wear to live longer

segments.text: People ask me all the time, what do you wear for longevity? So, I'm going to get into what I wear to live longer. So, number one is a wide-brimmed hat. About 80% of visible skin aging is from UV. A hat with a brim that's wider than 7.5 cm cuts the UV hitting your cheeks and face by up to 70%. It also cuts the UV reaching your eyes by about half. And UV is one of the leading causes of cataracts. Second is a handkerchief.

Around 80% of skin cancers show up around the head and the neck. is cheap and cotton and it doesn't wear off like sunscreen does. I carry my handkerchief in my bag at all times cuz it's a great emergency solution. Third is ear protection. Hearing loss is among the biggest [music] modifiable risk factor for dementia. Mild loss doubles the risk and severe loss can increase it by five [music] times. A concert is over 100 decibels and in 15 minutes of exposure, that's permanent damage. Next is 100% cotton clothing. Microplastics are really scary. They've now been found in human blood, in the brain, and even the placenta. But, the science isn't conclusive. So, whether wearing

synthetic clothing hurts you is still up for debate. That said, I try to mitigate the potential risk just in case. And it's bad for the environment, too. Synthetic [music] textiles are 35% of microplastics in the ocean. Lastly, I carry around a stainless steel cup. [music] Pouring hot coffee into a paper cup can shed 25,000 microplastics in just 15 minutes. What a lot of people don't realize is that paper cups are actually lined with plastic. So, I carry my stainless steel cup everywhere I go.

I call it my emotional support cup. If you're new here, I'm becoming the world's most measured female, characterizing my menstrual cycle extensively. If you want to know any tips, comment them below. [music]
